title: Almost optimal well-posedness for Chern--Simons gauged $O(3)$ sigma model under the Lorenz gauge
summary: In this paper, we study the low-regularity Cauchy problem for the Chern--Simons gauged $O(3)$ sigma model in $\mathbb{R}^{1+d}$ ($d=1,2$) under the Lorenz gauge. For $d=1$, we establish local well-posedness for initial data $(\boldsymbolφ_0,\mathbf{A}_0)\in H^{s_1}(\mathbb{R})\times H^{s_1-1}(\mathbb{R})$ with $s_1>\frac12$. This improves the previous result of Jin and Huh \cite{HJ} by one quarter of a derivative and is almost optimal in view of the scaling-invariant regularities $\dot H^{1/2}(\mathbb{R})$ for the matter field and $\dot H^{-1/2}(\mathbb{R})$ for the gauge field.
